raw.purpose: Source bytes or factual source snapshots before SantosDia normalization.
raw.durability: Primary scarce evidence is immutable where rights permit; regenerable bulk bootstrap evidence may be bounded only after durable canonical derivation exists.

normalized.purpose: Source-specific structured assertions without claiming canonical truth.
normalized.durability: Keep versioned last-known-good packages sufficient to reconstruct canonical decisions.

canonical.purpose: Reviewed stable identities, claims, relationships, names and tombstones owned by SantosDia.
canonical.durability: Perennial and versioned; fixed-ring overwrite is forbidden.

releases.purpose: Reproducible publication snapshots and manifests derived from canonical knowledge.
releases.durability: Perennial for published releases; fixed-ring overwrite is forbidden.

changes.purpose: Delta reports, source freshness, corroboration and live/source-monitor observations.
changes.durability: May be bounded when regenerable, except evidence referenced by a canonical claim or review decision.

conflicts.purpose: Unresolved identity, authority, calendar, language or source conflicts requiring review.
conflicts.durability: Retain until resolved and preserve the resolution receipt thereafter.

rights.purpose: Reuse status, restrictions, source terms and content-rights decisions.
rights.durability: Perennial and versioned because publication rights can change independently of facts.

rollback.purpose: Import receipts, release bookmarks, staging verification and recovery metadata.
rollback.durability: Bounded operational receipts are allowed, but every published release keeps a durable recovery bookmark/manifest.

migration.rule: Existing archive streams remain readable until replacement manifests are written, verified and rollback-tested.
